forecasts.raw_text: SE winds 5 to 10 kt. Seas less than 2 ft or less. Wave detail: SE 1 foot at 3 seconds. Bay and inland waters light chop. A chance of showers and tstms early this evening, then a slight chance of showers and tstms late this evening and early morning.
